Name: Blackstone
description: The Blackstone 17" Tabletop Griddle delivers 12,000 BTUs via an H-style burner for even heat, with a portable design perfect for tailgates or camping. Its hood and Rear Grease Management System simplify cleanup, ideal for outdoor cooks seeking compact power.

Name: Pit Boss
description: The Pit Boss Classic Pellet Grill offers 700 sq. in. of porcelain-coated space and 8-in-1 versatility from 180–500°F. With a digital controller and flame broiler, it’s perfect for wood-fired grilling, smoking, and more, for groups of 4–6.

Name: Big Green Egg
description: The MiniMax Big Green Egg is a compact ceramic grill with 133 sq. in. of cooking space, built for portability with an easy-grip carrier. Ideal for tailgates and camping, it delivers premium performance in a small, durable form.

Name: Kamado Joe
description: The Kamado Joe Classic Joe II is a 46 cm ceramic charcoal grill with 1613 cm² of space, featuring the Air Lift Hinge, Kontrol Tower vent, and Divide & Conquer system. Built for precision and ease, it’s ideal for grill enthusiasts ready to elevate their game.

Name: Traeger
description: The Traeger Pro 780 is a wood pellet grill with 780 sq. in. of space, WiFIRE® app control, and TurboTemp® tech for fast, consistent cooking. Ideal for smoking, roasting, or baking, it suits tech-savvy grillers seeking wood-fired flavor and smart features.

Name: Char-Broil
description: The Char-Broil 4-Burner Gas Grill delivers 32,000 BTUs with an added 10,000 BTU side burner, porcelain-coated grates, and electronic ignition. With storage and mobility features, it’s great for backyard chefs wanting performance and convenience.
